snippet.title: Late Shift  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890610?utm_source=youtube

Experience Mark’s story through found footage as he becomes stuck in a loop whilst working the late shift at the cinema. Spot the anomalies and survive the night. Ensure that every room is checked thoroughly.
